correctness.rationale: The affine coordinate change is invertible, preserves normalized areas, and puts all 45 chord and side segments in Q(√5)². Exact intersection and split-edge deduplication is essential at multiple crossings; the cyclic half-edge traversal counts bounded faces rather than cycles from unsplit diagonals. The separately written and run reproduction /workspace/branches/82cc46dd-df40-4e84-a28e-93484fc1d518/independent_decagon_check.py gives (V,E,F)=(171,390,221), with one outer face, and agrees with all twelve exact normalized areas and multiplicities. Independently, using area (a+b√5)/200, the target pair is (10,0) and the integer functional 4a+9b has per-class values (6,2,5,1,4,2,1,8,4,0,4,8). Fewer than five cannot sum to 40; five would require only classes 7 and 11 and their radical coefficient would be 80j−40, never zero. Unpruned exact pair enumeration at size six (12,376 multisets) gave just (4,8,11,11,11,11) and (7,8,10,11,11,11); the source's 6,186 retained prefixes through size five also recompute correctly. These patterns have sufficient distinct cells and give 20²·C(20,4)=1,938,000 and 10·20·30·C(20,3)=6,840,000 subsets, a total of 8,778,000. The subset count concerns minimal witnesses and does not assert connectedness or exclude larger witnesses. Source copies were read, not executed. Malformed TeX control characters in the displayed binomial-count line do not affect the unambiguous count or its independently reproduced derivation.
